observations: The joined source fragment is a complete reference-frame question, not an unfinished q1 or a request to change the frame at each spatial point.

English preserves the question modality, the current-carrying conductor and the entire surrounding-space scope. Throughout is consistent with the Chinese regional statement, not a new assumption. Magnetic induction denotes B here, not magnetic flux through a surface.

Field transformation is a valid scientific topic, but whether a single frame can remove B over the requested region depends on the electric and magnetic fields and the charge/current model. A conductor carrying conduction current and a charged distribution carrying convection current cannot silently be treated as the same stipulated model.

The isolated candidate supplies neither a specified charge/current model nor an inertial-frame restriction. This is a condition-completeness HOLD, not a claim that the original wording or translation is factually false.
No yes/no solution, example solution or new assumption has been inserted.

Both source lines survive as the one original question. Transmitting/receiving roles, mutual perpendicular placement and oscillations in the receiver are translated without changing the object or asking for a different quantity.
An unspecified oscillator is not automatically a specified linear electric-dipole antenna; orientation of generic circuit boxes alone does not define coupling.

Even in the electric-dipole radiation model, the driving field is projected relative to the transmitter-to-receiver direction. Mutual perpendicularity of the two axes alone does not state the needed spatial geometry. Near-field effects and reflections also cannot silently be ruled out by the frozen wording.
The minimal unresolved datum is the intended oscillator/antenna model and relative placement for the polarization demonstration, not a demand for a realistic receiver engineering specification.
The English candidate preserves the same ambiguity; this is not a translation defect. No binary answer has been authored.

The source value L=2 times10 to the minus4 henry and the capacitance interval12 to450 picofarads are retained. The negative exponent is unchanged; picofarads are not converted into nanofarads, microfarads or farads by the translation.

Both LaTeX spans, $L=2\times10^{-4}$ and $C$, match exactly across source, Chinese, English and mapping. Both interval endpoints and their unit remain outside the formula in the same mathematical role.

For the ordinary textbook ideal tuned-LC interpretation, the supplied positive inductance and two capacitance endpoints determine a resonance/tuning interval. The LC dimensional relation and frequency-to-wavelength interpretation are consistent; this does not promise exact loaded practical-receiver passband performance.

English range of wavelengths makes explicit the interval already implied by varying C between two supplied endpoints. It neither adds a third endpoint nor changes the mathematical task into bandwidth, frequency, transmitted wavelength or a single fixed-capacitance calculation.

Figure120 is explicitly required by q3 and is present in both draft figure manifests. The original lesson's figures array records the on-page127 only; it does not erase the separate shared120 exercise reference.

The retained independent RAW120 text observation describes a coil and parallel variable capacitor in a receiver schematic. It is reused only at that already reviewed schematic scope; SOURCE157's old non-RAW gate is not promoted.

This PASS is for scientific task text under the standard ideal textbook circuit interpretation. Modern Figure120 delivery and rendered task usability remain unapproved. No wavelength endpoints or answer key have been calculated or written.

observations: Both languages ask about the oscillation direction of the magnetic induction vector of the emitted wave, not the electric vector, antenna mechanical vibration or the direction in which the wave travels. Television station faithfully conveys the television center in this context.
Figure127, its explicit q4 use and the source refs are unchanged. Its unique figure-to-q4 owner PASS is inherited, not reassigned.

This reviewer's prior RAW127 observation establishes a horizontal-looking aerial in a partial roof/facade drawing. It establishes no printed propagation ray, polarization vector or specification of the incident wave. Drawing perspective is not a measured three-dimensional incidence direction.

An antenna shape/orientation alone does not establish that the received field is a single linearly polarized plane wave optimally aligned with an ideal electric dipole. A definite spatial B-oscillation direction requires the relevant incident-field/propagation and matching model.

The open wording can legitimately invite only a limited or conditional judgment. This HOLD does not declare that such an open conceptual question is false; it withholds an unconditional antenna-picture-to-polarization inference for the isolated modern task.
No vertical/horizontal answer, polarization arrow, unseen transmitter position or receiving-efficiency assumption was added.
The one complete source row survives as an open qualitative comparison of radio-wave propagation conditions on the Moon and Earth.

English fundamentally different faithfully preserves 本质区别; neither language asserts that the conditions are identical, that radio requires an atmosphere, or that propagation performance is universally identical at all frequencies and along all paths.
The task asks for a qualitative comparison, not a numerical communication range or a specified-frequency link budget. Those unrequested engineering parameters are not made into new mandatory gates.

A sound discussion must distinguish the electromagnetic law from environmental/path conditions; the text does not predetermine that discussion's answer. No answer, numerical assumption or universal environmental assertion was inserted.
questions.independentScientificReasoning: Validity and scope of the open comparison request; no empirical lunar propagation-performance claim is approved
